title: The Prophecy from Three Years Ago
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought he had calculated everything, a familiar figure appeared silently at the city gate of the Imperial Capital, covered in dust from travel—Chen Nian, she was actually alive, and in her hands she held the last heirloom from the Chen Family secret chamber.

text.content: The news Su Qingyao brought was like a basin of cold water, splashing Chen Ji awake from his contemplation. The Fate Writer, the Fourth Force... His fingers unconsciously rubbed the jade pendant on his chest, where the fragment of the Tianji Record was hidden. The moonlight outside the window was frosty, illuminating his calm face, yet unable to penetrate the turmoil in his heart at this moment. Three years had passed, yet everything from that night remained as vivid as yesterday—

【Three Years Ago · Chen Family Secret Chamber】

In the dim secret chamber, thirteen-year-old Chen Ji knelt before the ancestral tablets, his whole body trembling. Not from fear, but because of the ancient tome glowing with a faint ethereal light before him—the Tianji Record. It had appeared in his hands as if from thin air, as if it had been waiting a thousand years for this moment. "Remember, every time you peer into the future, you are spending your life." An aged voice rang out in his mind—it was Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: "Child, do you know why the Tianji Record chose you?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of weariness. "Because you carry the blood of Chen Xuan, and because on the day you were born, a celestial omen descended—an omen even the eyes of Heavenly Providence could not completely hide. You are the variable, the sole unknown in this chess game."

Just then, the door was pushed open, and a little girl with two buns hairstyle poked her head in, her eyes sparkling: "Brother! I knew you snuck here again! Father said you're not allowed in this room!" Chen Nian was only nine, a robust and spirited child who wasn't the least bit afraid of those eerie ancestral tablets.

text.content: Chen Ji hastily stuffed the Tianji Record into his embrace, but accidentally made a soft "snap" sound. Chen Nian blinked her eyes and suddenly revealed a mischievous smile: "Brother, what good thing are you hiding? Did you secretly eat candy? I'm going to tell Mother!" As she spoke, she rushed over to search his body.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was both amused and helpless. He scooped up the little girl and hoisted her onto his shoulder: "Little ancestor, shall I take you to see fireflies? Don't make trouble." Chen Nian fell for this trick every time, immediately cheering and wrapping her arms around his neck in delight. This scene was heartwarmingly bittersweet—Chen Ji at that time didn't know it would be the last time he could so easily carry his sister on his back.

Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed again, carrying a warning tone: "Boy, the Heavenly Fate your sister carries is far too dense... The Holy Sect will eventually come knocking. You must gather nine pages of the Tianji Record within three years, otherwise—" He didn't finish, but the meaning was abundantly clear. "What will happen to me otherwise?" Chen Ji asked. "You will die." Mo Xiansheng answered bluntly, "Quite miserably."

text.content: Chen Ji's reaction at that time surprised everyone—including Mo Xiansheng. He didn't cry, didn't panic, didn't even tremble. He quietly absorbed the Tianji Record into his body, then gently pinched his sister's cheek on his shoulder: "Niannian, Brother might not be able to accompany you always from now on." Chen Nian was counting his hair and froze at these words: "Brother, what are you talking about? Niannian wants Brother to accompany her forever!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled, that smile appearing especially gentle yet especially cruel in the dim chamber: "Niannian, if one day Brother becomes a very, very bad person, will you forgive Brother?" How could Chen Nian understand such things, busy tugging at his ears: "Brother is silly! Brother is the best!" What she didn't know was that Chen Ji had already made a vow in his heart—even if he fell into the endless abyss, he would protect this silly girl.

choice.prompt: Recalling to this point, a bitter smile appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. The choice three years ago created today's predicament. If time could flow backward, how would he choose?

choices.description: Choosing to cooperate with fate, cleverly using the abilities of the Tianji Record to secretly accumulate strength, and biding his time.
choices.risk_hint: Risk of Fate's Retaliation During This Period

text.content: Mo Xiansheng nodded approvingly: "Good child, understanding how to seize momentum rather than resist it—this is what a true wise person does. The Tianji Record granted you foresight, but didn't give you the ability to change—yet it gave you the time difference to alter outcomes. Make good use of these three years and lay out your plans across the world."

dialogue.content: From that day on, Chen Ji began his "waste cultivation path." On the surface, he appeared talentless and cowardly, but in truth, he cultivated diligently every night and secretly studied all the Chen Family books. Three years later, he had become the "biggesttrash" among the servant disciples of the Tianqing Sect—but only he knew how many hidden pieces he had already positioned.

choices.description: Choosing to completely hide the existence of the Tianji Record, not even telling his sister, enduring everything alone.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian sensed something was off about her brother that night, but couldn't pinpoint what exactly. She only remembered that when Brother carried her to watch fireflies, his back seemed much thinner than before. When the Holy Sect later took her away, her biggest regret was not being able to see Brother one last time. "Brother, how many things have you been hiding from me?" This was the final question she wanted to ask before being taken away.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng sighed: "You child, your heart is even harder than the Tianji Record. Bearing everything alone—is that courage or cowardice? Perhaps both. But... someone like you can indeed make the chess game cleaner."

choices.description: Refuse to be manipulated by fate, attempt to forcibly unravel the secrets of the Tianji Record, seek methods to change cause and effect.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng was startled by his idea: "Kid, are you insane? The Tianji Record is the eye of the Heavenly Dao, and you're provoking it—" Chen Ji interrupted him: "Then I'll gouge out this eye. My life is determined by me, not by Heaven." That was the first time he showed his true edge before Mo Xiansheng. Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while, then suddenly laughed: "Good, very good. Bold and arrogant enough—this is how a descendant of Chen Xuan should be."

text.content: That night, Chen Ji attempted to use the Tianji Record to foresee "how to escape the control of the Tianji Record." The result was a blurry image—a person who looked exactly like him, standing atop ruins, with countless corpses lying beside him. Was that him? Or... another possibility of fate? He dared not think about it.

【Three Years Later · Tianqing Sect】

The memories receded like the tide, and Chen Ji opened his eyes to find himself still sitting by the window. Su Qingyao's message still lay on the table, the ink not yet dry. Fate Scribe... Interesting. He suddenly thought of something, and the corners of his mouth lifted slightly.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted over: "What are you thinking, kid? Smiling so sinisterly." Chen Ji shook his head: "I was thinking—three years ago I chose to endure and lie low, and today Su Qingyao brings news of the Fate Scribe... If the other party is also a fragment holder of the Tianji Record, then our meeting might not be coincidence." Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "What are you trying to say?" Chen Ji stood up, walked to the window, and looked toward the brightly lit Xuanwu Sect in the distance: "I want to say—the hunter sometimes becomes the prey. But what I want to know more is: is this 'Fate Scribe' a Chess Player, or a Chess Piece?"

text.content: Just then, a commotion suddenly came from outside the window. Chen Ji frowned and looked up to see a meteor-like sword light streak across the night sky, heading straight for Tianqing Sect. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of astonishment: "This aura... something's wrong, it's—" Before the words finished, a familiar voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind: "Brother!!"

choice.prompt: Chen Nian?! Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Three years—he had searched the entire world without finding his sister, and now she was—

choices.description: Suppress the excitement in your heart, first confirm whether the visitor's identity is genuine, then make plans.
choices.risk_hint: The other party might be merely an illusion

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. Three years—he had heard this voice countless times in dreams, yet every time he woke to empty joy. This time... was it real? He closed his eyes and activated the Tianji Record, attempting to foresee the scene three breaths later. However, what appeared before him was a blur—as if something was interfering with his foresight. "It's Nian Nian," he murmured. "Her existence makes foresight blurry..."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare gravity: "The Heavenly Fate Key power in your sister is awakening... She can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight, do you understand what this means?" Chen Ji naturally understood. This meant Chen Nian was not only his weakness but also the only variable in his resistance against the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

choices.description: Regardless of whether it's a trap, confirm your sister's safety as the first priority.
choices.visible_reward: See Sister at the Earliest Possible Moment
choices.risk_hint: The Other Party May Have Set an Ambush

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's figure flashed and vanished from where he stood. Mo Xiansheng exclaimed: "Hey! You little—" But Chen Ji couldn't be bothered with that anymore. Three years of endurance, three years of planning—all were thrown aside by him at this moment. What use was playing the fool to devour the tiger, what use was flawless scheming—if he couldn't even protect his sister, what was the point of cultivating, what was the point of calculating fate?

text.content: When he appeared outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, he happened to see a dust-covered girl leaping down from the sword light. Her face had grown much more mature than three years ago, her features carrying a hardness they hadn't possessed before, yet those sparkling eyes remained exactly as they had been in childhood. Chen Nian spotted him, freezing for an instant before her eyes reddened: "Brother..." That single word caused all of Chen Ji's carefully constructed facades over three years to crumble in this moment.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian rushed into his embrace, sobbing loudly: "Brother, I've been searching for you for so long... They said you were dead, I don't believe it, I don't believe it!" Chen Ji gently stroked her back, his voice somewhat hoarse: "Silly girl, how could your brother die? I promised to protect you." He lifted his gaze and saw Chen Nian clutching an ancient-looking box tightly in her hand. "What's this?" Chen Nian looked up at him with tear-filled eyes: "Father asked me to give this to you before he passed away... He said it's the Chen family's final secret."

text.content: Chen Ji took the box, his fingers trembling slightly. The truth behind his father's "death" from illness three years ago, he had never spoken of to outsiders. But now, holding his long-lost sister, gazing at this box bearing the Chen family's final secret, he suddenly felt that the choice he had made three years ago... perhaps truly had not been wrong. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, carrying a hint of emotion: "Boy, your chess game begins a new phase from today."

Under the moonlight, Chen Ji held Chen Nian, long silent. He didn't know what this box would bring, nor what his sister had endured over these three years. But one thing he was certain of—no matter how dangerous the path ahead, he would never let anyone harm her even slightly. In the distant shadows, a pair of eyes watched this scene, the corners of their lips curving into a meaningful smile...
